title: Violence | Slavoj Žižek | Talks at Google
summary: Slavoj Zizek discusses his book Violence in an Authors@Google talk in New York. He covers ideology, including his idea of the unknown knowns.
why: Recommended as a relatively clear introduction to Zizek's thinking, especially his account of ideology and unknown knowns.

quote.text: when it comes to discussing ideology, he's doing the best outreach bar none.
